name: io.github.kofujimura/tctc-mcp
description: ERC-7303 token-controlled roles for AI agents: grant, check, and revoke permissions on-chain

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Path to the role/chain config JSON (see examples/ in the repo; the secret-free Sepolia demo config works out of the box)

environmentVariables.name: TCTC_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Issuer key enabling grant_role/revoke_role (admin mode). Omit for read-only mode: state-changing tools are then not even registered

environmentVariables.name: TCTC_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's own EOA key, also read from ./.env.local (create one with `tctc-mcp agent init`). Its address becomes the default subject, and whoami returns a dashboard link signed by it. It never signs transactions

environmentVariables.name: TCTC_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name for the agent on the dashboard

environmentVariables.name: TCTC_DASHBOARD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the dashboard the signed agent link points to (default https://tctc-mcp.vercel.app/)
